Wall samples (dimensions of 60 mm × 60 mm × 11 mm) were fabricated by melting the pre-alloyed powder in an EOS M290 LB-PBF machine operating under a high-purity argon atmosphere. Fabrication was carried out on a build plate heated at a constant temperature of 100 °C. The power was kept constant at 370 W and the laser scan speed was set at 1400 mm/s with a laser spot size of 80 μm. The processing parameters were optimized for a layer thickness of 60 μm to produce samples free of lack-of-fusion defects. A bidirectional scanning strategy with a 110 μm hatching distance and a rotation of 67° of the scanning pattern between two consecutive layers was used.
